title: [Bug]: Notebook, Chess Example. Bug with copied config.
body:
### Describe the bug

The error line are below.
It happens because we use the copied version of the BoardAgent
when we check the owner of the registered function with the line

hook_list = self.hook_lists[self.process_all_messages]

from the code below.

```python
    def process_all_messages(self, messages: List[Dict]) -> List[Dict]:
        """
        Calls any registered capability hooks to process all messages, potentially modifying the messages.
        """
        hook_list = self.hook_lists[self.process_all_messages]
        # If no hooks are registered, or if there are no messages to process, return the original message list.
        if len(hook_list) == 0 or messages is None:
            return messages

        # Call each hook (in order of registration) to process the messages.
        processed_messages = messages
        for hook in hook_list:
            processed_messages = hook(processed_messages)
        return processed_messages
```

In ConversableAgent.register_reply function,
we can fix the bug with the fixation. However, there must be the reason to pass the copied config.
Another way to debug the problem would be needed.

```python
self._reply_func_list.insert(
    position,
    {
        "trigger": trigger,
        "reply_func": reply_func,
        ## To fix the bug, we need to remove copy.
        "config": copy.copy(config),
        "init_config": config,
        "reset_config": reset_config,
    },
)
```


### Steps to reproduce

Just run 
the line in agentchat_chess notebook.

```python
player_black.initiate_chat(player_white, clear_history=True, message="Your turn.", silent=False)
```

Additional Info : 
I installed autogen using source with the command below with very recently cloned repository.

pip install -e .

_No response_
